summary.en: Open on the first print, read its claim, travel to the product, cut on a shared value, measure the gap, rise over the desk for the name.
summary.zh: 从第一张截图开场，读出它的主张，移到产品，在共同的值上切换，量出差距，升到桌面上方给出名字。

fits: Model and product launches whose argument rests on official tables and charts. 24–48 s.
notFor: Mechanism explainers; stories without published evidence.

intent.en: A launch argued like a case file: each claim pointed at in its own evidence, the gap measured, the route retraced.
intent.zh: 像卷宗一样论证的发布：每条主张都在它的证据里指出，差距量出来，最后重走一遍路线。

content.en: 3–5 real captures with sources; 1–3 cells to read; a value two of them share; two points on one chart.
content.zh: 3–5 张带来源的真实截图；1–3 个要读的格子；两张共有的一个值；一张图上的两个点。

fits.zh: 主张建立在官方表格与图表上的模型或产品发布。24–48 秒。

notFor.zh: 机制讲解；没有公开证据的故事。

waive.all: an own brick split from an existing style: no upstream shot; checked instead side by side with the original template at the same moment (card, Differs from upstream)
